in_sanskrit.name: Noty
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Thought
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Noty एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit root 'nidh' meaning 'to think' or 'to reflect'. The name 'Noty' signifies the one who is the lord of thoughts, the one who ponders and contemplates deeply.

The name 'Noty' signifies the one who is the lord of thoughts, the one who ponders and contemplates deeply.
